_comment: Parametrized coverage floors for the PR Coverage Gate (LBA-REQ-016 CM / ISO-IEC-IEEE 29119). These are the fail-under thresholds c8 enforces. Ratchet them UP with `npm run coverage:bump` (raises each floor toward the measured coverage by at most `step`, capped at `target`); never lower them by hand. Measured at adoption: lines/statements 73%, functions 62%, branches 49%.
